description: Adjust the current process for one observed defect. Costs 1 call. PREFERRED (option A): pass business_id (the same ID you used in first_shot) plus defect_info only - the server loads the stored previous process from the archive automatically, so you do NOT need to resend all parameters. Alternatively pass process_no (the value returned by first_shot). FALLBACK (option B): if the process was not stored, pass current_params with the COMPLETE process - copy EVERY key/value from the first_shot 'parameters' array as key->value pairs, including ML0, MEL, VPTL, all IP0/IP1/IP2, IV0/IV1/IV2, IL0/IL1/IL2, PP0/PP1, PT0/PT1, PV0/PV1, BT1..BT4, MP0, MSR0, MBP0, CT, NT and the stage counts. Passing only a few keys (e.g. NT, IP0, CT) produces wrong results. defect_info is an array of {desc: defect code, level: severity}. Call schema first for defect codes. Also pass available context (polymer_abbreviation, product_ave_thickness, injector_max_injection_pressure, actual_injection_peak_pressure) when known.

actual_fast_injection_speed.description: Measured fastest injection speed in mm/s.

actual_injection_peak_pressure.description: Measured peak injection pressure in MPa.

actual_vp_position.description: Measured actual V/P switch position in mm.

business_id.description: The business ID you passed to first_shot. The server adds the per-subscriber prefix automatically - do NOT add a prefix. Passing this alone (with defect_info) loads the stored process from the archive, so you do not need to resend all current_params.

current_params.description: Optional. If business_id or process_no is given, the server loads the previous process from the archive and this can be omitted. If provided, copy EVERY key/value from the first_shot 'parameters' array; sending only a few keys (NT/IP0/CT) gives wrong results. Units are algorithm defaults (mm, mm/s, MPa, C, s).

DDAM.description: Decompression distance after metering in mm. Defaults to 5 if omitted.

IL0.description: Injection stroke end stage 0 in mm. Copy from first_shot parameters.

IL1.description: Injection stroke end stage 1 in mm. Copy from first_shot parameters.

IL2.description: Injection stroke end stage 2 in mm; must equal VPTL.

IP1.description: Injection pressure stage 1 in MPa. Copy from first_shot parameters.

IP2.description: Injection pressure stage 2 in MPa. Copy from first_shot parameters.

IV1.description: Injection velocity stage 1 in mm/s. Copy from first_shot parameters.

IV2.description: Injection velocity stage 2 in mm/s. Copy from first_shot parameters.

ML0.description: Metering (plasticizing) end position in mm. CRITICAL: if missing, MEL/VPTL/IL positions collapse to near zero.

MSR0.description: Screw rotation speed stage 0 in rpm.

actual_fast_injection_speed.description: Measured fastest injection speed in mm/s. Used by speed ceiling guard.

actual_injection_peak_pressure.description: Measured peak injection pressure in MPa. Provide when known.

actual_mould_temp.description: Measured mould temperature in Celsius. Improves cooling and viscosity rules.

actual_product_weight.description: Measured part weight in g. Provide when known.

actual_vp_position.description: Measured actual V/P switch position in mm. Provide when known.

barrel_temperature_stage.description: Temperature zones including nozzle (NT is zone 0). Inferred from NT/BTn if omitted.

flow_length.description: Longest melt flow length in mm. Provide when known.

holding_stage.description: Number of holding stages. Inferred from PPn/PVn/PTn if omitted.

injection_stage.description: Number of injection stages. Inferred from IPn/IVn/ILn if omitted.

injector_max_holding_pressure.description: Machine max holding pressure in MPa. Provide when known.

injector_max_injection_pressure.description: Machine max injection pressure in MPa. Provide when known.

injector_max_injection_velocity.description: Machine max injection velocity in mm/s. Provide when known.

injector_max_screw_rotation_speed.description: Machine max screw speed in rpm. Provide when known.

metering_stage.description: Number of metering stages. Inferred from MPn/MSRn/MBPn/MLn if omitted.

min_buffer_position.description: Measured cushion / remaining screw position in mm. Provide when known.

polymer_abbreviation.description: Material grade, e.g. PP. Provide when known so material rules can evaluate.

product_ave_thickness.description: Average wall thickness in mm. Provide when known.

recommend_back_pressure.description: Material recommended back pressure in MPa. Provide when known.

recommend_melt_temperature.description: Material recommended melt temperature in Celsius. Provide when known.

level.description: Defect severity. Use one of the enum values, or a number from 0 to 1.

min_buffer_position.description: Measured cushion / minimum buffer position in mm.

process_no.description: The process_no returned by first_shot (already prefixed, e.g. k7-MOLD-A-100). Alternative to business_id for loading the stored process.

name: optimize
